name: Adelphi University
parkingNotes: Google Maps lists a wheelchair-accessible parking lot at Woodruff Hall. LIRR Nassau Boulevard station is a short walk.
accessibilityNotes: Google Maps lists a wheelchair-accessible entrance and parking lot for Woodruff Hall.
description: A private university in Garden City. Its continuing education program runs a public ballroom and social dance class on Friday evenings in the dance studio in Woodruff Hall (Room 304), which has a special floor that needs clean dance shoes.
reviewNotes:
Ballroom classes are a Continuing Education course (Ruth S. Ammon College of Education & Health Sciences) held in Woodruff Hall, Room 304. Dance-shoe rules apply on the special floor.

Directory research 2026-10-04: Social links are the university-wide accounts (linked from adelphi.edu), not dance-specific. The class contact on the course page is the School of Health Sciences, 516-877-4260, with a staff coordinator's personal work email (not recorded). The studio photo is the course page's own feature image; it may not be Room 304 itself. No hours recorded (campus building; class times are on the course page).
